Saudi Airport Attacked Again; Boxing Match Proceeds

Saudi Arabia's airport passenger terminal was struck for a second time, one day after an initial attack that killed 12 people. Despite the attacks, the boxing match between Alvarez and M'billi is scheduled to proceed. The attacks led to a fall in Saudi shares, with cautious trade observed in the Gulf region.
